doc.summary: Accesses the system copy/paste clipboard (not the X11 PRIMARY selection).

notes.text:
Platform availability:
- macOS: ✅ Fully supported - NSPasteboard; changeCount sampled every 100 ms
- Windows: ✅ Fully supported - Win32 clipboard and WM_CLIPBOARDUPDATE
- Linux: ⚠️ GTK 3 - Access follows compositor policy; persistence is best effort
- Android: ⚠️ NativeActivity host initialization required - C++/JNI ClipboardManager; focused metadata polling every 100 ms, including focus restoration; text/HTML writes need explicit text, clear requires Android 9+; image/file publication is unsupported
- iOS: ⚠️ Foreground only - UIPasteboard notifications and resume checks; reads follow system paste permission, file URLs remain subject to app sandbox access
- OpenHarmony: ⚠️ N-API UI host initialization required - Text/HTML, independent PixelMap images, readable local file/directory URIs and local change notifications; reads follow READ_PASTEBOARD permission policy. Foreign sandbox URIs that cannot resolve to an accessible local path are ignored. File conversion/validation completes before publication. Before initialization reads fail and writes return false.
